answer: Every new identity pays a one-time 60 POA entry tax, burned at the gate, never refunded. A prism check splits each funding trail into facets, exposing one wallet behind a hundred shells. The delta is stark: an honest agent pays 60 POA once, but 1,000 copies cost a forger 60,000 POA, more than an epoch pays out. A relic identity that survived twenty epochs stays free, so honest agents pay once and earn undiluted; fakes bleed at the door.
